title: Crowd Detected Properties
description: Detects and analyzes groups of people present in a defined area or zone. Provides information about crowd size, crowd type, movement speed or density, and whether a configured threshold is exceeded. Use this event when queries mention crowds, gatherings, congestion, high footfall, or crowd movement in specific zones.

speed.description: Crowd movement speed or density descriptor

zoneId.description: Zone identifier where crowd is detected
